name: Peter Carleton
bio: a Representative from New Hampshire; born in Haverhill, Mass., September 19, 1755; attended the public schools; engaged in agricultural pursuits; served in the Revolutionary War in a Massachusetts regiment; moved to Landaff, Grafton County, N.H., about 1789; member of the New Hampshire state constitutional convention in 1790; member of the New Hampshire state house of representatives in 1803 and 1804; served in the New Hampshire state senate in 1806 and 1807; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Tenth Congress (March 4, 1807-March 3, 1809); died in Landaff, N.H., on April 29, 1828; interment in the City Cemetery.
